howToRead.paths: members[].avatarUrl = a key of every element of an array; members{}.seen{} = a value of a record; notes[]<kind=mention>.anchor = inside one branch of a union (a discriminated one by its key, another one by <index:what it is>); responsible<null> / responsible<value> = the two sides of a nullable.
howToRead.visited: optionalKeys: present in at least one instance. arrays, records: not empty in at least one instance. branches: taken by at least one instance. enums: the values that occur.
howToRead.variants: Both variants count together (stopped, running): every file of each copy is an instance.
howToRead.why: "cannot": the code of this version has no way to write it (the reason names the code). "not-made": it can be written, and this fixture does not hold it (the reason says what it would take).
howToRead.enums: Every value of an enumeration that a stored file may hold. The ones that are not visited carry one reason for the whole enumeration; they are told for the reader and are not a gap of shape.
